title: Custom-domain redirects retain supported campaign attribution and matching page paths

source.ref: Daniel 2026-11-04 audit and approved improvement scope

detail: Current custom-domain subdomain308 redirects preserve paths but pass an empty query to subdomainSiteRedirect. Root and /book redirect verified live; ?utm_source is dropped. Prepare a tenant-bound, query-safe fix that preserves ISR/cache behavior, avoids uncached database work per request, does not leak credential/private query values, and does not alter unconfigured/unpublished/custom-domain eligibility. Coordinate with all custom-domain owners.

verify.evidence: Live HEAD checks on danieltyack.frequencylocal.com verified308 to danieltyack.com and /book to /book, with UTM loss. Acceptance: all configured host mappings, allowed query tags, rejected sensitive query values, same-page destination, no loops, no cross-tenant redirects, cache/latency and canonical/sitemap consistency. Prototype remains pending.
